thread:
nora: > rolling out elastic-quant-kernel (int8 fallback + dynamic-chunk packer) to a small canary (15%). saw promising bench numbers, posting quick summary and next steps.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started 1977654319 by nora 15% route -> model-serving:elastic-quant-kernel-v1

tariq: love the name. quick ask: were these numbers from offline bench or live traffic? any breakdown by seq length?

nora: live canary window (45m) on mixed customer workload: 
- p50 overall: -11%
- p95 overall: -7%
- p99 overall: -6% (mixed effect due to long seqs)
- p50 for long seqs (>2048 tokens): -28%
- p99 for long seqs: -30%
- avg GPU token-cost: -24% (int8 kernels + chunk packing)
- median throughput on each shard: +12%

jade: huge for long sessions. what triggers the int8 kernel vs fallback? any quality checks?

nora: decision logic: kernel selects int8 path when model.quant_profile == "safe_int8" AND seq_chunk_size <= 1024. fallback to fp16 kernel on high-entropy sequences (detected via token-entropy spike). quality guard: we run ngram-preservation and lm-perplexity checks asynchronously; if regression > 1.5% on nightly eval we auto-disable int8 for that model.

remy: did we hit any anomalies? memory/caching issues?

opsbot: NOTICE at 1977654365: packing misalignment observed in eu-west-1 causing increased p99 (~+18%) for 3min. Auto-adjust applied: dynamic-chunk.realign=true

nora: saw that. cause: an unexpected client traffic shape causing chunker to produce many small chunks leading to packer fragmentation. mitigation: lowered packer.min_chunk_tokens from 32 -> 16, enabled dynamic-realign, and warmed the chunk cache. rolled canary down 15%->8% for 4m during fix.

tariq: glad auto-monitoring caught it. any follow-up action items?

nora: follow-ups: 1) add a client-adapter telemetry tag to help trace chunk size distribution per customer, 2) run 6h stress tests simulating 1% of traffic with synthetic long sessions, 3) include eu-west tail metric in rollout gating. PR updated with these items.

jade: what toggle/flag do infra/oncall need if we need to stop this quickly?

nora: config flags: "serve.elastic_quant_enabled" and "serve.elastic_quant_min_count". hot toggle via infra toggle service. I added a quick rollback playbook in the PR notes.

remy: paste the curl to fetch live canary perf so I can script alerts.

nora: sure:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RBW_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.internal.redwood/infra/canary_metrics?exp=elastic_quant&window=45m&group=seq_len" | jq '.by_seq_len'
```

opsbot: AUTO-RULE: runtime.elastic_quant.eu-west.p99 > baseline*1.15 -> page oncall (slack:@oncall) and roll canary to 0%

oncall-bot: @oncall paging rule added for runtime.elastic_quant p99 threshold

tariq: what's the rollout cadence? slow ramp?

nora: cadence: current -> 30% in 2h if stable (no region p99 regressions, nightly eval pass), -> 60% after 12h, -> 100% after 48h with PM + ops sign-off. full rollback criteria documented in PR.

jade: can you link the PR + perf notebook for the sync slides?

nora: PR: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/pull/512 \u2014 perf notebook + raw traces are attached. Slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood/eng-runtime/weekly/2026-03-23/elastic-quant.pdf

remy: I'll add the eu-west tail check to the oncall dashboard and update the runbook. thanks for the quick triage.

nora: thanks team. will update when we hit 30% or if anything regresses. :rocket:
